description: Convenience tool — returns the most-recent issue summary (same shape as one element of ic_signal_list_issues.issues[]). No auth required. Args: { include_stories?: boolean (default false — when true the issue's story list is inlined as stories[] with id/title/dek, saving a follow-up ic_signal_get_issue round trip) }.

include_stories.description: true inlines the issue's stories (id, title, dek). Default false.

name: ic_signal_get_latest

outputSchema.description: The tool's JSON result. Every field the tool's description names is present at the top level; ok, error and error_kind follow the shared envelope.

error.description: Why the call failed, in a sentence a person can act on. Present only when ok is false.

error_kind.description: Machine-readable failure class: no_token, missing_scope, forbidden, not_found, invalid_input, rate_limited or transient

ok.description: true when the call did what it was asked; false with `error` and `error_kind` when it did not

result.description: The tool's value when it returns a list or a single value instead of an object

text.description: The tool's reply when it returns plain text instead of JSON

title: Get the latest SIGNAL issue summary (public)
